description: Pull Meta Ads raw JSON snapshots from the Meta Graph API while preserving SabeenManekia raw-file contracts.

auth_env_var_specs.name: META_ACCESS_TOKEN
auth_env_var_specs.description: Meta Graph system-user access token. Read from env only; never pass as argv.

auth_env_var_specs.name: META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: Meta ad account ID such as act_123.

auth_env_var_specs.name: META_BUSINESS_ID
auth_env_var_specs.description: Meta business ID for business-level resources.

auth_env_var_specs.name: META_GRAPH_API_VERSION
auth_env_var_specs.description: Optional Meta Graph API version override. Defaults to v21.0.

novel_features.name: SabeenManekia raw snapshot parity
novel_features.description: Writes the legacy Meta raw JSON filenames consumed by the SabeenManekia sheet and Supabase import flow.

novel_features.name: Secret-safe Graph paging
novel_features.description: Uses Authorization headers, strips access_token from paging URLs, redacts HTTP errors, and omits page access tokens from pages.json.
